Fully Funded PhD in Sustainable Development and Climate Change 2026–2027 in Italy

Applications are now open for the 42nd Cycle of the National PhD Programme in Sustainable Development and Climate Change, coordinated by the Scuola Universitaria Superiore IUSS Pavia in collaboration with leading Italian universities and research institutions.

The three-year programme offers 35 funded PhD positions across climate science, environmental sustainability, public policy, health, economics, engineering, energy, agriculture, artificial intelligence, circular economy and other interdisciplinary fields.

🎓 Programme Benefits:
💶 Annual PhD scholarship of €18,645.63
📚 Full funding for the entire three-year doctoral programme
🔬 At least 20% additional annual research funding
✈️ Up to a 50% scholarship increase during approved research periods abroad
🌍 International and interdisciplinary research environment
🧠 More than 160 hours of training and seminars
🏛️ Access to leading Italian universities and research institutions
🧳 Opportunities for international research, conferences and professional development
🗣️ English-taught academic and research activities
🌿 Specialized research opportunities covering health, society, technology, climate and territorial transition

📅 Application Deadline:
August 26, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. CEST

🔗 Application Information: https://t.co/0MG5Xo37Lf 

💡 Pro Tip
Carefully review the available research topics before applying.
